item.title: Celebrations
item.description: Holidays, weddings and birthdays: talking about special days.

children.definition: to do something special and enjoyable for an important day or event
a day when most people do not work, often to celebrate something
children.example: Navruz is a public holiday in Uzbekistan.

children.definition: a ceremony when two people get married
children.example: My cousin's wedding was in a big hall with hundreds of guests.

children.definition: a person you invite to your home or to an event
children.example: We had twenty guests for dinner last night.

children.definition: to ask someone to come to a party or event
children.example: Dilnoza invited all her classmates to her birthday party.

children.definition: something you give to someone, for example on their birthday
children.example: I bought a gift for my sister.

children.definition: to make a place look nice with flowers, lights or other things
children.example: We decorated the room with balloons.

children.definition: done or made in the same way for a very long time
children.example: Sumalak is a traditional Navruz dish.

children.definition: to tell someone you are happy about their good news or special day
children.example: Everyone congratulated Timur on his new job.

children.definition: bright coloured lights that explode in the sky at celebrations
children.example: We watched the fireworks over the city at New Year.

children.definition: the same date as an important event in an earlier year
children.example: My parents celebrate their wedding anniversary every June.

children.definition: a special time of celebration, often with music, food and events
children.example: Our town has a music festival every summer.
